## 🌟 About Lyra Music Organization (`lyraMusicApp`)

Welcome to the official GitHub organization for **Lyra Music** ([github.com/lyraMusicApp](https://github.com/lyraMusicApp)). Our goal is to craft a premium, high-performance, and completely private Android music streaming player powered by **Jetpack Compose**, **Material You dynamic styling**, and open-source audio engines.

### 🛡️ Safety & Protection Guarantees
- **Zero Tracking**: 100% telemetry-free and tracking-free.
- **Data Protection**: All library metadata, playlists, and cached audio stay strictly on your device.
- **Signed & Verified Releases**: Every APK artifact published is cryptographically signed and published with SHA-256 integrity verification.
- **Coordinated Disclosure**: Active security policy and private vulnerability reporting via [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/lyraMusicApp/lyra-music/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
